description: This is a test class for the SecurityUtil utility in the org.apache.ofbiz.security package. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of permission checking methods such as checkMultiLevelAdminPermissionValidity.

classes.name: SecurityUtilTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing security permission validation methods.

methods.name: basicAdminPermissionTesting
methods.description: Tests basic permission validity for various permission strings using checkMultiLevelAdminPermissionValidity.

methods.name: multiLevelAdminPermissionTesting
methods.description: Tests multi-level admin permission validation with different permission strings.

methods.name: multiLevelBadHierarchyPermissionTesting
methods.description: Tests invalid multi-level permission hierarchies to ensure they are correctly rejected.
